source.title: Review snapshot
source.evidence: `tests/audience-controls/segments.spec.ts` — “[CONT-008][CONT-017][AUD-001][AUD-002][AUD-005][AUD-007][SEG-001][CONT-011] build and copy a saved segment, inspect its saved audience time and separate channel step counts, freeze recipients and merge identities without widening consent”. Acceptance 1: step “Review snapshot — saved as-of time and email recipient-step counts” in `tests/audience-controls/segment-journey.ts` brackets checks independently, reconciles the exact saved time with native and persisted readback, and renders the saved rule and time after reload and reopen. Acceptances 2 and 3: step “Review snapshot — separate email and SMS recipient-step counts” in `tests/audience-controls/channel-snapshot-journey.ts` uses three natively confirmed email contacts, one explicitly excluded contact, one confirmed SMS destination and one pending SMS destination: three candidates, one excluded, two eligible contacts, every saved exclusion reason and count, four email recipient steps over two steps and three SMS recipient steps over three steps. Native readback, persisted rows and labeled review counts agree after reload and reopen, with unchanged draft, approval, recipient and dispatch authority; browser proof at 1440 and 390. Existing rule, email permission and exclusion assertions remain. Native AU SMS confirmation uses the Mobile Message network edge; this proves review counts, not live SMS qualification. Owner-held Twilio A2P and US carrier registration, SMS transport and qualification remain held under SMS-001, SMS-002 and SMS-008. Provider, device, account, cross-seed and Base prerequisites, rer 0.2.95 adoption, CONT-013’s SPLIT and NEW-1 disposition and original fix-1 hold, and all release prerequisites remain unchanged.
